learningCandidates.summary: New read-only API resources: add to_dict() on model, new app/api/<res>.py, register in app/api/__init__.py
learningCandidates.content: To add a GET-only token-authenticated API endpoint for a model in this Flask app: (1) add a to_dict() method on the SQLAlchemy model in app/models.py returning plain JSON-serializable fields (datetimes via .replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()); (2) create app/api/<resource>.py with a route decorated with @token_auth.login_required from app.api.auth, using db.get_or_404(Model, id) which auto-triggers the shared HTTPException errorhandler in app/api/errors.py for 404s with an {'error': ...} JSON body; (3) import the new module in app/api/__init__.py's bottom import line (from app.api import users, errors, tokens, posts) so the blueprint registers the route. Tests run via `python -m unittest discover -q` (pytest is not installed in the venv).
appliesWhen: Adding a new read-only token-authenticated JSON API endpoint to this Flask microblog app
limitations: Does not cover write endpoints (POST/PUT) or pagination collection endpoints
reusableFor: Debugging why a new api submodule route 404s (missing import in app/api/__init__.py)
